panel.ai-not-song: Classified as not a song by AI
panel.ai-setup-before: Set up AI features in the
panel.ai-setup-after: to search for the lyrics on the web

youtube_fallback.label: YouTube fallback
youtube_fallback.description: Use YouTube metadata and chapters; extract album tracklists when chapters are missing.

yt_dlp_path.label: yt-dlp binary path
yt_dlp_path.description: Leave empty to find yt-dlp in PATH, or enter an absolute executable path.

llm_backend.label: AI · Provider
llm_backend.description: Choose an AI provider to identify songs, read album tracklists, and find lyrics when the lyric databases can't. Select Disabled to turn off AI features.

automatic_ai_fallback.label: AI · Automatic fallback to AI lookup (skips confirmation)
automatic_ai_fallback.description: Start an AI lookup automatically when direct lyric sources have no result. When off, use the Look up with AI button.

openai_api_key.label: AI · OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Saved in plain text in Noctalia settings.

openai_endpoint.label: AI · OpenAI endpoint
openai_endpoint.description: API base URL including /v1. Web lookup requires a Responses API endpoint with provider-run web search.

anthropic_api_key.label: AI · Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Saved in plain text in Noctalia settings.

gemini_api_key.label: AI · Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Saved in plain text in Noctalia settings.

xai_api_key.label: AI · xAI API key
xai_api_key.description: Saved in plain text in Noctalia settings.

groq_api_key.label: AI · Groq API key
groq_api_key.description: Saved in plain text in Noctalia settings.

mistral_api_key.label: AI · Mistral API key
mistral_api_key.description: Saved in plain text in Noctalia settings.

llm_max_tokens.label: AI · Output token limit
llm_max_tokens.description: Enter a positive whole number. Maximum output tokens per request, including reasoning where applicable. Must be supported by the selected model.

llm_database_search_limit.label: AI · Lyrics database search limit
llm_database_search_limit.description: Enter a positive whole number. Maximum lyrics database queries per song identification attempt.

llm_web_search_limit.label: AI · Web lyrics browsing limit
llm_web_search_limit.description: Enter a positive whole number. Maximum provider web searches and page fetches per lyrics lookup, where supported.

llm_album_page_limit.label: AI · Album browsing limit
llm_album_page_limit.description: Enter a positive whole number. Maximum provider web searches and page fetches per tracklist lookup, where supported.

openrouter_api_key.label: AI · OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Saved in plain text in Noctalia settings.

openrouter_model.label: AI · OpenRouter model
openrouter_model.description: Model for track identification with web search.

album_art_only.description: Show only the album artwork (no text).
album_art_only.label: Album art only

hide_album_art.description: Hide the artwork and its fallback icon.
hide_album_art.label: Hide album art

hide_when_no_media.description: Hide the widget when no MPRIS player is active.
hide_when_no_media.label: Hide when no media

local_lyrics_dir.description: Folder with local .lrc files named 'Artist - Title.lrc'; searched before LRCLIB.
local_lyrics_dir.label: Local lyrics folder

max_length.description: Maximum widget length in pixels — the text area width (long titles scroll or truncate to fit it).
max_length.label: Max length

offset_ms.description: Shift lyric timing: positive values show lines earlier, negative later.
offset_ms.label: Lyrics offset (ms)

panel_size.description: Size preset of the lyrics panel: compact (440), medium (520), large (640). The bar widget and control-center tile open this preset.
panel_size.label: Panel size

player_allowlist.description: Comma-separated player names (identity or bus name). When set, only matching players are shown. Empty = show any player.
player_allowlist.label: Player allowlist

player_blocklist.description: Comma-separated player names (identity or bus name) to hide. Empty = hide none.
player_blocklist.label: Player blocklist

show_lyric_line.description: Show the current synced lyric line in the chip instead of the artist (title stays).
show_lyric_line.label: Show current lyric line

title_scroll.description: Scroll long titles that exceed the max length.
title_scroll.label: Title scroll

use_cache.description: Store fetched lyrics in the plugin data directory for offline reuse.
use_cache.label: Cache lyrics
